purpose: Correct only the missing persisted baked-Data state exposed by retained attempt-44, then prove cross-process Mesh-only reconstruction from byte-exact copied Data.

retainedFailure.finding: The exact copied Data roster was admitted, but an ordinary source blend retained has_cache_baked_data=false and Blender removed the copied cache at process teardown before any Mesh bake.

sourceBasis.rnaFinding: has_cache_baked_data maps directly to the FLUID_DOMAIN_BAKED_DATA bit in FluidDomainSettings.cache_flag and is writable through RNA.
sourceBasis.editorFinding: A successful bake_data end job sets the same FLUID_DOMAIN_BAKED_DATA bit; this correction adopts an already verified complete cache without invoking bake_data.

authority.allowed: Two fresh local-only Blender processes: one exact-state cache adoption and save, then one reopen, Mesh bake and save; zero Data bake/render/network/engine remote write.

processes.actions: Reconstruct exact attempt-42 scene state before cache binding; verify exact 14-file Data manifest; require initial has_cache_baked_data=false; set only has_cache_baked_data=true; verify readback and unchanged Data; save data-adopted-state.blend with relative cache path.

Require persisted has_cache_baked_data=true and exact scene/Data identities; bake Mesh once with radius 9.0 and upper concavity 3.5; verify unchanged Data and exact seven Mesh files; measure and save mesh-reconstructed-state.blend.

stopRule: Stop on retained failure/input/Data drift, non-fresh roots, dirty research tree, scene-state mismatch, initial baked-Data flag unexpectedly true, unwritable or unpersisted adopted flag, any Data byte change, missing reopened adopted state, any Data bake, more than one adoption/Mesh bake or two saves/starts, cache roster mismatch, scientific threshold failure, symlink, banned media or resource failure. Preserve attempt-44 and do not repeat Data or tune a surface variable.
claimCeiling: One C1 cross-process cache-state adoption plus Mesh-only reconstruction from accepted Final Data. A PASS proves exact cache reuse and static seven-frame surface thresholds only; it does not prove general cache import safety, slow tip, impact, lighting, camera or finished-film quality.
